# UDSLib

> UDSLib is a portable C99 implementation of ISO 14229-1 (UDS) with ISO-TP over CAN and CAN-FD. No heap allocation, 27 application services, MISRA-C:2012 checked in CI. Free for noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial license 5,000 EUR.

## Pages

- [Home](https://udslib.com/): overview, services, comparison with iso14229
- [Examples](https://udslib.com/examples.html): 19 worked examples
- [FAQ](https://udslib.com/faq.html): timing, ISO-TP, DTC, flashing, porting, licensing
- [Pricing](https://udslib.com/pricing.html): free and commercial terms
- [UDS toolbox MCP server](https://udslib.com/mcp.html): free MCP tools for decoding UDS, ISO-TP and DTCs
- [White paper](https://udslib.com/whitepaper.html): architecture
